summary.request: We service equipment for our customers and need to manage maintenance contracts. Each contract gets a number from a number series and has a customer, a start date, an end date and a status. Users must be able to find contracts in a list and open them on a card. Only the service team may create or change contracts; everyone else can only view them.
summary.business-process: Service management master data: a new custom Maintenance Contract entity (no posting process involved)

objects.purpose: Master table: one record per maintenance contract. Primary key "No." Code[20] only; number assigned in OnInsert from the setup's number series through codeunit "No. Series" when "No." is blank; "No." OnValidate guards manual entry with NoSeries.IsManual before clearing "No. Series". Table-level DataClassification so every field inherits a real classification (no ToBeClassified).

fields.name: No.
fields.note: Sole primary key; assigned from the number series in OnInsert when blank.

fields.name: No. Series
fields.note: Editable = false; TableRelation = "No. Series"; records the series that produced No.

fields.name: Customer No.
fields.note: TableRelation = Customer; type and length must equal Customer."No." exactly - confirm against the Customer table definition. OnValidate tests the customer's Blocked value (see open question customer-blocked).

fields.name: Ending Date
fields.note: Relation to Starting Date is an open question (end-date-rule).

objects.purpose: Named contract states for the Status field, instead of an Integer or magic numbers. Values are an open question.
Singleton setup table: "Primary Key" Code[10] left blank as the only key; holds the contract number series.

fields.name: Contract Nos.
fields.note: TableRelation = "No. Series"; TestField before the contract table uses it.

objects.purpose: Card page over the setup table with InsertAllowed = false, DeleteAllowed = false and an OnOpenPage guard that inserts the blank row if missing; searchable with UsageCategory = Administration.
List page users search for and open contracts from; UsageCategory = Lists with an object-level ApplicationArea; opens the card page. Name describes its source table. No business logic on the page.
Card page for one contract. Field rules (numbering, customer validation, dates, status) live on the table, not in page triggers. Every user-facing field has an explicit or inherited tooltip.

Building block, Assignable = false: R on tabledata Maintenance Contract and Maintenance Contract Setup, plus X on the contract table, the setup table and the list and card pages. Explicit entries, no wildcards.

Building block, Assignable = false, includes Maint. Contract - Read; adds the insert and modify rights on tabledata Maintenance Contract that the service team needs (delete is an open question). Explicit entries, no wildcards.
Role-shaped, Assignable = true, includes Maint. Contract - Read: everyone outside the service team can view contracts only.
Role-shaped, Assignable = true, includes Maint. Contract - Edit: the service team creates and changes contracts.

data-flow.note: OnInsert: if No. is blank, Get setup, TestField("Contract Nos."), store it in No. Series, assign No. with NoSeries.GetNextNo. Callers that create contracts in code use Insert(true).
TableRelation to Customer validates the value; OnValidate gets the customer and tests its Blocked value at this point of use.
Any date or status rule belongs on the table fields, not on the page.

data-flow.to: Maintenance Contract List and Card (search and open)
data-flow.note: Users find contracts through Tell Me on the list page (UsageCategory = Lists) and open them on the card.

lifecycle.step: Setup card creates the singleton row on first open; an administrator assigns the contract number series before contracts are created. Contract insertion fails with a TestField error while the series is blank.

Ship two non-assignable building blocks (Read, Edit including Read) and two assignable roles (View, Service) composed with IncludedPermissionSets; enumerate every object explicitly with no wildcards; verify the grants fall within the entitlement the target users hold.
Set a table-level DataClassification on both new tables and override only fields that store a different kind of data; no field may ship as ToBeClassified.

No install code is required for the design as requested. If the setup row or a default number series must exist after installation (open question default-number-series), put it in a Subtype = Install codeunit; install code does not run on version upgrade.

First version needs no upgrade code. Any later data change to contracts or setup goes in a Subtype = Upgrade codeunit guarded by HasUpgradeTag/SetUpgradeTag with a per-feature tag, not DataVersion checks.
Place all contract objects (tables, enum, pages, permission sets, tests) in one feature folder, consistent with the repository's existing layout convention.

tests.given: Setup has a contract number series created through test library codeunits
tests.when: A contract is inserted with Insert(true) and a blank No.
tests.then: No. is the next number from that series and No. Series equals the setup's Contract Nos.

tests.given: Setup exists with Contract Nos. blank
tests.when: A contract is inserted with a blank No.
tests.then: A TestField error on Contract Nos. is raised and no contract is created

tests.given: The contract number series does not allow manual numbers
tests.when: A user validates a typed No. on a contract
tests.then: An error is raised and No. Series is not cleared

tests.when: Customer No. is validated with that customer's No., and separately with a value that is not a customer
tests.then: The existing customer is stored; the non-existent value is rejected by the table relation

tests.given: A customer created with LibrarySales.CreateCustomer and blocked with the Blocked value(s) chosen in open question customer-blocked
tests.when: Customer No. on a contract is validated with that customer
tests.then: An error on the customer's Blocked field is raised

tests.given: No Maintenance Contract Setup record exists
tests.when: The Maintenance Contract Setup page is opened
tests.then: Exactly one setup record with a blank Primary Key exists

tests.given: TestPermissions = Restrictive and the test user lowered to the Maint. Contract View role, with an existing contract
tests.when: The user reads the contract, then tries to insert and to modify a contract
tests.then: Reading succeeds; insert and modify fail with a permission error

tests.given: TestPermissions = Restrictive and the test user lowered to the Maint. Contract Service role, with a contract number series in setup
tests.when: The user creates a contract and changes its Status
tests.then: Both operations succeed and the contract carries a number from the series

knowledge.used-for: Decision checklist for the new contract entity: table type, numbering, setup, data rules, privacy, pages, permissions, install/upgrade, tests, layout.
constraints: Plan every decision row before building, not only the table and page.
A row the request does not settle is a question for the requester, not a default to assume.

knowledge.used-for: Classify Maintenance Contract as a Master table and Maintenance Contract Setup as a Setup table.
constraints: Master: primary key Code[20] named No.; Card + List pages.
Setup: exactly one record; primary key Code[10] named Primary Key, always blank; one page that creates the singleton on first open.

knowledge.used-for: Contract numbering.
constraints: No. Code[20] is the sole primary key; a non-editable No. Series Code[20] records the source series.
OnInsert checks No. is blank, reads setup, TestFields the series, stores it in No. Series and assigns No. from the series.
Not an Integer AutoIncrement, GUID or SystemId business key.

knowledge.used-for: Number-series API for assignment and manual-entry guard (applies from BC22).
constraints: Assign with codeunit "No. Series" GetNextNo; guard manual No. entry with IsManual or TestManual.
Do not use obsolete NoSeriesManagement InitSeries/TestManual.

knowledge.used-for: Maintenance Contract Setup table and page.
constraints: Primary Key Code[10] is the sole key, value blank.
Card page with InsertAllowed = false, DeleteAllowed = false, and an open-time guard that inserts the blank row if missing.
No Integer key, no List page over the setup.

knowledge.used-for: Guard on the contract number series before use.
constraints: TestField the required setup field before use instead of falling back silently.
Write a test that blanks the setup field and asserts the error.

knowledge.used-for: How code and tests create contracts.
constraints: Create master records with Insert(true) so OnInsert assigns the number, unless the caller itself does the trigger's work.

knowledge.used-for: Customer No. validation on the contract.
constraints: The referencing record tests the master's Blocked at the point of use (OnValidate of the reference field).
An option-style block needs the specific option compared at each relevant path.

knowledge.used-for: Sizing Customer No.
constraints: For an unconditional TableRelation, the field has the same type and exact length as the related field, read from its table definition.

knowledge.used-for: Classification of both new tables.
constraints: A table-level DataClassification is inherited by Normal fields of that table; override at field level only where the field stores different data.

knowledge.used-for: Release readiness of the new fields.
constraints: No field may ship as ToBeClassified; choose the classification from the data's content.

knowledge.used-for: Naming of list, card and setup pages.
constraints: A page name must describe the table it shows.

knowledge.used-for: Where contract rules live.
constraints: Business operations and cross-entry-point invariants belong in a codeunit or the table, not only in a page trigger.
A setup page reading and writing its own singleton record and the OnOpenPage singleton-initialization idiom are conventional.

knowledge.used-for: Tooltips on the contract and setup pages.
constraints: Every user-facing page field needs a non-empty explicit or inherited tooltip.
On runtime 13.0 (BC24) or later define the tooltip on the table field; before that, on the page field.
Do not invent effects, defaults or constraints in tooltip text.

knowledge.used-for: Type of the Status field.
constraints: A fixed set of named, mutually exclusive states is an Enum, not an Integer.

knowledge.used-for: Folder placement of the feature's objects.
constraints: Group a feature's objects together consistently with the project's chosen convention; do not mix schemes.

knowledge.used-for: Making the contract list (and setup page) findable.
constraints: Pages users open directly set UsageCategory and an object-level ApplicationArea.
Supporting objects reached only through another page do not need to be searchable.

knowledge.used-for: Execute entries for the new pages and tables.
constraints: Give exposed objects an explicit execute entry in a permission set shipped by the app.

knowledge.used-for: Structure of the view-only and service-team permission sets.
constraints: Small building blocks marked Assignable = false; role-shaped Assignable = true sets reference them through IncludedPermissionSets.

knowledge.used-for: Content of the permission sets.
constraints: Enumerate each tabledata and table entry; no * wildcards.
Grant only the letters required: R for read-only consumers, RIM for editors that do not delete, RIMD only for owners of the data.

knowledge.used-for: Validating the permission sets against user licenses.
constraints: Every right the set grants must be reachable within the target users' entitlement; grants beyond it are clipped silently at runtime.

knowledge.used-for: Install versus upgrade code.
constraints: Install codeunits run on first install and reinstall only; version migration goes in a separate Subtype = Upgrade codeunit.

knowledge.used-for: Future data changes.
constraints: Each upgrade procedure starts with HasUpgradeTag and ends with SetUpgradeTag; no DataVersion branching.

knowledge.used-for: Test fixtures.
constraints: Create customers and other prerequisites with library codeunits such as LibrarySales.CreateCustomer and LibraryRandom; create parents before dependents and Validate foreign keys.

knowledge.used-for: Permission tests for viewer and service-team roles.
constraints: Use TestPermissions::Restrictive and lower the test user with Permissions Mock or Library - Lower Permissions before the protected operation.
Lowering through a role that includes the permission set under test is adequate.

knowledge.used-for: Test structure.
constraints: [FEATURE] once per codeunit; [SCENARIO] first in each test; [GIVEN]/[WHEN]/[THEN] mark setup, action and assertions.

open-questions.question: Which statuses can a contract have (for example draft, active, expired, cancelled), what is the initial status, and which transitions are allowed or automatic (e.g. when the end date passes)?
Must the end date be on or after the start date, and are both dates mandatory or may an open-ended contract have no end date?
Which Customer Blocked values (Ship, Invoice, All) should prevent assigning a customer to a contract, and should existing contracts be affected when a customer is later blocked?
May the service team delete contracts, or should contracts only change status? This decides whether the Edit permission set grants D.
Who maintains the contract number series in Maintenance Contract Setup: the service team, or administrators only?
Should installation create a default contract number series and setup row, or will an administrator configure it, and is a guided (assisted) setup wanted?
May users type a contract number manually when the series allows it?
Do contracts need further data such as a description, the serviced equipment or contract lines? Lines would make this a Document-type design.

Which Business Central version, countries and application area does the app target? This decides the tooltip placement (table field from BC24/runtime 13.0) and confirms the No. Series codeunit (BC22+).
Is CustomerContent the right table-level classification for contract data, or does any field hold personal data needing a different value?

unresolved: context: bc-version, countries and application-area are unknown; no repository was supplied.
Customer."No." length (Code[20]) is assumed from standard Business Central and was not confirmed against repository symbols.
End-date and status-transition rules are not covered by BCQuality knowledge; any such validation rests on the agent's judgment and the answers to open questions.
Read-only access for non-service users relies on permission sets alone; no BCQuality article covers making the pages non-editable per role.
